title: ci(test-ui): run the always-on tests as their own lane on slot 1
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb2LA2JnEAZZtpjjP7Vho5eB)_

Fixes #31914

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么:** affected 运行里，选择器判定的「常驻测试」（包图无法定位的测试，今天 510 个文件）单独跑在 slot 1，作为常驻通道；其余选中的测试照 PR 1（#31939）的规则装进 slot 2..N+1，最多 15 路。常驻集合由选择器新增的 `--lane-out` 每次运行时算出，不另存清单。全量运行不变，仍是 16 路 `--shard=k/16`，没有通道。另外修了合同评审的 nit F1：互为子串的测试路径（如 `x.test.ts` 和 `x.test.tsx`）总是排在同一路，这一路只把最短的那个路径交给 vitest。
- **为什么改:** #31914 的第二条要求：整树门禁类测试单独成一条固定通道，分片里只放能按包定位的测试。PR 1 已经按选中的测试规划分片数，本 PR 补上这条通道，卡片就此完成。
- **风险与回滚:** 计划作业失败时仍回落到 16 路全量，覆盖不会少。通道那一路和其它分片一样，要核对自己实际跑的文件、发出凭证，`Test UI` 汇总照旧清点。一个只改单个包的 PR 有时会多起一路（例如改 `plugin-kanban`：9 路变 10 路），每多一路约多 133 runner-s。最慢一路的墙钟不变，约 11 分钟。回滚就是 revert 本 PR，必需检查名不变，不用改设置。
- **先看:** `ui/scripts/plan-test-ui-shards.mjs` 的 `planRun`（通道与 `filterUnits`）；`ui/scripts/select-affected-tests.mjs` 的 `--lane-out`；`.github/workflows/ci.yml` 的两个 select 步骤、计划步骤和槽位步骤，各只多一个参数。
- **两分钟验证:** `cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run scripts/__tests__/plan-test-ui-shards.test.ts scripts/__tests__/select-affected-tests-wiring.test.ts`，再跑 `pnpm exec vitest run scripts/__tests__/select-affected-tests.test.ts -t lane-out`。
- **需要你做的:** 合同评审后手动合并（Tier H，改了 `ci.yml`）。分支保护不用动。

## What changes

- **`ui/scripts/select-affected-tests.mjs`: `--lane-out FILE`.**
  - On `mode=affected` it writes the verdict's own always-on files, one ui-relative path per line. These are the tests the run selects only because the package graph cannot place them.
  - `--out` is unchanged, and so is every verdict.
  - A `mode=full` verdict writes no lane.
  - The lane is the very set this run computed, so it cannot drift from the selector, and no list or gate is kept beside it.
  - It moves with the change. A file of an affected package leaves the lane, because its package's directory filter already selects it. An empty diff gives a 510-file lane; a `plugin-kanban` change gives 421.
- **`ui/scripts/plan-test-ui-shards.mjs`: `plan --lane FILE`, affected plans only.**
  - Slot 1 runs every selected file that is always-on.
  - The rest is packed as in PR 1 into slots 2..N+1. N = clamp(ceil(P_rest / D), 1, 15), where P_rest is the rest's predicted seconds and D is the same full-battery density, computed from the dataset on each run.
  - A selection with nothing outside the lane is the lane alone, `[1]`.
  - The plan records `lane` and `laneMs`, and the digest covers `lane`.
  - A full plan with `--lane` is refused, because the lane belongs to affected runs only (ruling 6739581615).
  - A lane path that the selection did not collect is named in the plan log. Nothing is invented for it. Today there are 0 such paths.
- **Paths that are vitest filters of each other (contract review 6742203717, nit F1).** Vitest reads a positional as a case-insensitive substring of the path, and `vitest-invocation-guard.mjs` refuses an argv in which one positional contains another.
  - `filterUnits()` groups such paths into one unit, and a unit is always packed on one slot. It goes to the lane when any member is always-on.
  - `files` hands vitest only the shortest path of a unit, through `slotFilters()`. Vitest still runs the whole unit, and `verify-ran` checks all of it.
  - `plan` refuses a selection that has the shorter path but not the longer one, since no leg could run that selection exactly. A selection that came from vitest's own filters cannot do that, so the refusal only fires on lists from two different trees.
  - This tree has 0 such pairs today. Without the fix, a future pair would turn an affected leg red, either through the guard or through `verify-ran`.
- **`.github/workflows/ci.yml`:** four arguments, one per step.
  - Both select steps (the plan job's and the leg's, still byte-equal) pass `--lane-out "$RUNNER_TEMP/always-on-tests.txt"`.
  - The plan step's affected branch and the slot step's affected branch pass `--lane` with that file.
  - The `test-ui-plan` header comment now describes the lane.
  - No job, `needs:`, permission, matrix or name changes.

### Accepted deviations (ruling 6739581615)

- The lane is the selector's computed always-on set, 510 files on today's tree (509 when the card was filed), not the card's "~230". The ~230 was a projection made after routes the maintainer declined, and no shipped code can name it.
- The lane runs in affected mode only, so "on every UI run" is read as "on every affected UI run". Full runs already run everything on 16 sequencer legs. A 17th lane there would save nothing, and it would need an out-of-fence edit to `ui-test-timings-refresh.yml`.

### The wall and runner-s change

| Selection (today's tree) | PR 1 | This PR |
|---|---|---|
| Empty diff (always-on only, 510 files, 1,731 predicted-s) | `[1]` | `[1]`, which is now the lane |
| `apps/console` change (806 files, 4,347 s) | 3 slots | 3 slots: lane (495 files) + 2 bins |
| `plugin-kanban` change (3,097 files with the heavy-setup edge, 16,349 s) | 9 slots | 10 slots: lane (421 files) + 9 bins |
| The whole selection as affected (6,671 files) | 16 | 16: lane + 15 |

The lane leg weighs at most about D, so it takes about 11 min (133 s + 0.313 × 1,731 s). That matches PR 1's slowest leg and stays off the critical path. Where packing the lane apart starts one more leg, the run costs about 133 more runner-s.

## Tests

- `ui/scripts/__tests__/plan-test-ui-shards.test.ts`: 25 cases, 8 of them new.
  - The lane is slot 1 and the rest is in slots 2..N+1 by the count rule.
  - A lane-only selection plans `[1]`.
  - The roster is 16 with the lane taking one slot, including a 15-way cap on the rest. A roster of 1 puts everything in the lane.
  - No lane plans exactly as before. A full plan refuses a lane.
  - The partition holds with a lane over 30 random selections.
  - `filterUnits` groups a case-insensitive pair and refuses a selection that lacks the longer path. The pair lands on one slot, or in the lane, and `slotFilters` keeps only the shorter path.
  - CLI `--lane`.
- `ui/scripts/__tests__/select-affected-tests-wiring.test.ts` (16 cases): the pull_request run's slot 1 runs exactly the real selector's `--lane-out`, and its plan log names the lane. Every selected file still runs exactly once.
- `ui/scripts/__tests__/select-affected-tests.test.ts`: one new case. `--lane-out` matches the `--explain` always-on list, each lane file is matched by an `--out` filter, and a bare `--lane-out` exits 2.
- **Ablations:**

  | Ablation | Red cases |
  |---|---|
  | Remove `--lane` from both `ci.yml` plan steps | 1 wiring case |
  | Remove `--lane` from the leg's slot step only (digest mismatch) | 4 wiring cases |
  | Drop the union in `filterUnits` | 2 planner cases |
  | Lane membership by a unit's first path only | 1 planner case |

## Acceptance notes

<details><summary>A real lane leg runs exactly its planned files</summary>

On this branch, the empty-diff plan is `[1]`, the lane, with 510 files. Its files were run for real:

- the command was `pnpm exec vitest run -t <no match> --reporter=json --outputFile.json=F` plus the lane's 510 paths, from `plan-test-ui-shards.mjs files --slot 1`;
- vitest exited 0;
- `verify-ran --slot 1` printed `✓ Test UI slot 1/16 (affected) ran exactly its 510 planned file(s).`

</details>

<details><summary>Still owed after landing (the card's acceptance, read by the seat)</summary>

- For three real one-package UI PRs: the Test UI shards each started, and its Test UI runner minutes.
- For one empty-diff UI run: the shard count, which should be 1 (the lane), and the lane's wall time.
- For one full run: every test at 16 legs, with attestation green. The 16:00Z scheduled run is the first full-mode run since PR 1 landed.

</details>

## Verification

<details><summary>Gates</summary>

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --ran F`: **61 derived, 61 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN**, all exit 0.
  - The run built every package first, as the leg does.
  - `check:pm-dispatch-gates` and `check:query-options-erasure` timed out at 300 s while the build was running. Both were rerun alone and exited 0.
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` (under `os-verify-lock`): 171 files passed and 2 skipped; 5,061 tests passed and 2 skipped; exit 0.
- `check:dts-closure`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check:lean-entry-closure`: all exit 0 after a full `turbo run build`.
- Not derived by dispatch-gates, but run anyway:
  - `ui` `check:entry-guard` (Lint UI): exit 0;
  - `eslint` on the five touched ui files: exit 0;
  - `ui` `type-check:scripts`: exit 0.
- `origin/main` was merged before opening. The merge touched none of this PR's files, and the three touched test files were green after it (112 tests).

</details>
